messages:
maya: Pinging team — customer reported the Console usage graphs for tenant acme-corp are flat zeros starting ~2026-03-17T02:10Z. They say API calls succeed but the dashboard shows 0 tokens for multiple routes. Can someone look?

jonathan: Thanks — can you paste the tenant id and a sample request id / time range? Any recent deploys?

maya: tenant_id=acme-corp-prod, sample request_id=req_8f3a2c, window=2026-03-17T01:00Z..2026-03-17T05:00Z. No platform deploys in that timeframe per deploy-bot. Customer notes billing preview also shows zero for that window. :frowning:

ingest-bot: ALERT: hourly_aggregator_consumer lag > 10k for partition tenant=acme-corp-prod at 2026-03-17T02:16Z (lag=12540).

leo: I pulled the consumer offsets — it looks like the hourly-aggregator consumer fell behind around 01:50Z. Offsets stalled due to occasional timeouts talking to storage during compaction. Excerpt from consumer log: 

-----
[2026-03-17T01:49:58Z] ERROR consumer-agg - write to s3://usage-archive/part-2026-03-17-01 failed: TimeoutError: socket hang up
[2026-03-17T01:50:02Z] WARN  consumer-agg - retrying batch (attempt=3)
[2026-03-17T01:52:10Z] INFO  consumer-agg - recovered, processed 4 batches
-----

leo: Looks like retries caused the consumer to fall behind and our downstream hourly materialized table didn't receive rows for those hours. I'm digging into whether the compaction job correlated.

anita: Dashboard note — the console uses the hourly_usage_partitioned table and a materialized view refresh that expects near-real-time inserts. If the upstream Kafka consumer stalls for >5m we show zeros (we don't currently surface partial counts). We should avoid zeros by showing a "data delayed" indicator.

jonathan: Can we run a targeted backfill for acme-corp for 01:00..04:00 window? What's the safest command to replay only that tenant and time range?

leo: Yes. Backfill plan: 1) pause alerts for that tenant, 2) run replay script against kafka topic offsets for that tenant, 3) rehydrate hourly table, 4) refresh mv. Command I used in staging: 

```
# replay offsets for tenant
python tools/replay_topic.py --topic usage-events --tenant acme-corp-prod --from-time 2026-03-17T01:00Z --to-time 2026-03-17T04:00Z --dry-run=false
# rehydrate hourly table
psql analytics -c "INSERT INTO hourly_usage_partitioned (tenant, hour, tokens) SELECT tenant, date_trunc('hour', ts) as hour, sum(tokens) FROM replay_buffer WHERE tenant='acme-corp-prod' GROUP BY tenant, hour ON CONFLICT (tenant, hour) DO UPDATE SET tokens = hourly_usage_partitioned.tokens + EXCLUDED.tokens;"
```

leo: I'll queue the job now. I'll keep it to single-tenant so we don't overload the materialized view.

tara: Before running, can we confirm retention/locking? Also assign oncall to watch pipeline and infra. I'll open an incident so we have an audit trail.

maya: Incident opened: INC-2026-315 (linked). Adding tara and leo.

leo: Starting replay at 2026-03-17T02:25Z. ETA ~10m. Monitoring consumer lag and materialized view refresh times.

anita: FYI the dashboard cache TTL is 5m, so even after backfill the Console might take a few minutes to show corrected numbers. I'll invalidate the dashboard cache for acme-corp once backend confirms updated rows.

leo: Replay finished at 2026-03-17T02:34Z. Insert stats: 3 rows for hours 01, 02, 03 with tokens=(1243, 987, 1102). Ran MV refresh; completed in 40s. Logs: 

-----
[2026-03-17T02:30:12Z] INFO replay -  batch processed: 4k events
[2026-03-17T02:32:58Z] INFO db - hourly_usage_partitioned upsert completed (rows=3)
[2026-03-17T02:33:10Z] INFO mv - refresh completed in 40.2s
-----

anita: Cache invalidated at 2026-03-17T02:36Z. Customer console should reflect numbers now (give it ~2m).

maya: Customer confirmed at 02:40Z that numbers are back and billing preview shows expected tokens. They asked what happened and whether this could impact invoices — flagged for CS.

jonathan: Root cause hypothesis: storage compaction I/O spikes caused transient timeouts which slowed the Kafka consumer, creating a lag window. Follow-ups: 1) add a "partial data" banner in Console when hourly partition timestamps are missing, 2) add an alert for consumer lag > 5k for >5m, 3) harden retries with jitter to avoid long stalls, 4) run compaction during low-traffic windows.

tara: Agreed. I'll create infra ticket for compaction schedule and retry policy. leo, can you add a one-off monitoring dashboard to track consumer processing rate vs s3 write latency?

leo: Yep — creating dash now. Also adding a backfill playbook snippet to run per-tenant replays safely.

maya: Marking as resolved for the customer side — customer happy. Leaving action items open in INC-2026-315. :white_check_mark:

ingest-bot: INFO: backfill-job finished for tenant=acme-corp-prod (status=success, rows=3, duration=00:09:12)

anita: Postmortem note: we'll make dashboard display a "data delayed" state and schedule a priority to detect consumer stalls before they hit customer dashboards.

tara: Closing incident after follow-ups scheduled.

maya: Thanks everyone.
